title: Weekly Writer Predictions: Cal vs. NC State Football 2026
text:
Weekly Writer Predictions: Cal vs. NC State Football 2026 
 Write For California 
 Subscribe Sign in Weekly Writer Predictions: Cal vs. NC State Football 2026
 Welcome to our weekly predictions post from our writers. You’ll see what they expect the score to be and any wacky or rational predictions they expect to see in each game!
 +1 Christopher Helling , Callie Wake , Berkelium97 , and 2 others Oct 30, 2026 5 9 Share Cal Football @ CalFootball Eastbound 🛫
 #GoBears 10:59 PM · Oct 29, 2026 · 3.01K Views 3 Replies · 8 Reposts · 72 Likes Christopher Helling 
 Scoreline: Cal loses 31-24 
 This is 100% a game that Cal should win on paper, and Cal’s best chance to win for the remainder of the season (Stanford is ostensibly worse, but rivalry games are always close; plus Stanford just beat NCSU). Keep in mind, “best chance to win for the remainder of the season” now means “7-point underdog.” Yikes.
 Callie Wake 
 Scoreline: Cal wins 28-27 
 This one’s gonna be a rock fight, and not even the fun kind of rock fight. Major concern is that neither team looks very good in the 2nd half/4th quarter, so things could derail miserably for either side after halftime. Either a lot of points are scored in the 4th, or none. Regardless, I’d recommend buckling your seat belt.
 Berkelium97 
 Scoreline: Cal wins 31-30 
 Playing on Halloween against an NC State team that just fired its coach, meanwhile Cal is in free fall? Sounds like someone is primed for a dead cat bounce. Whoever wins, it’s going to be weird.
 Piotr T Le 
 Scoreline: Cal loses 25-21 
 Cal loses and somehow achieves scorigami!
 Ben 
 Scoreline: Cal wins 28-17 
 Dead Cat bounce be gone. Its Halloween. Its spooky. Its a 9 AM game. NC State’s Offensive Line is porous. The game will have mistakes, the offense won’t look outstanding, but they’ll do enough to comfortably win.
 5 9 Share Previous Next Discussion about this post
 Comments Restacks Oski Disciple 14h The way this season is going I have to think we win this one and perhaps even in impressive fashion. Coming out of a bye we'll then get battered by Virginia. We bounce back to win the Big Game (please, please, please) and who knows what the hell happens against Pitt but given their recent form and a chance for bowl eligibility we probably pull it out. Now that I've written this I realize that it looks ridiculously optimistic but then I am a Bear fan of many years and thus not prone to rationality. 
 Reply Share justbearly 15h I really would like to see some more beautiful passes and actual receptions from JKS to his receivers tomorrow. I just like to watch him play. Anyway, if the game is no good, I have plenty to do outside tomorrow.
